workflowDefinition.name: SOC Argus — Frontier Simulator (M2.4)
workflowDefinition.description:
Argus Frontier Simulator — emits labelled Mythos-era corpus events into .soc-eval-corpus-<corpus_id> to simulate an adversary running live variants.
The full labelled corpus is pre-seeded at setup time by setup.sh from soc-simulation/scripts/argus-variant-bank/ (see the README there). On every tick this workflow picks a random variant, re-emits it with a fresh @timestamp and a unique emission id, so downstream consumers see a realistic "attacker re-runs primitive" stream.
Runs only when the Mythos-class adversary preset is armed — see soc-argus-arm-mythos-preset.yaml, which flips .soc-difficulty-state.preset_armed = "level-6".

script.source: ctx._source['@timestamp'] = params.now; if (ctx._source._argus == null) { ctx._source._argus = new HashMap(); } ctx._source._argus.is_simulation_emission = true; ctx._source._argus.source = params.src; ctx._source._argus.emission_id = params.emid; ctx._id = params.emid;

with.message: Frontier simulator: preset not armed, skipping emission

_source.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Argus — Frontier Simulator (M2.4)
description: >
  Argus Frontier Simulator — emits labelled Mythos-era corpus events into
  .soc-eval-corpus-<corpus_id> to simulate an adversary running live variants.

  The full labelled corpus is pre-seeded at setup time by setup.sh from
  soc-simulation/scripts/argus-variant-bank/ (see the README there). On every
  tick this workflow picks a random variant, re-emits it with a fresh
  @timestamp and a unique emission id, so downstream consumers see a realistic
  "attacker re-runs primitive" stream.

  Runs only when the Mythos-class adversary preset is armed — see
  soc-argus-arm-mythos-preset.yaml, which flips
  .soc-difficulty-state.preset_armed = "level-6".

enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 30m
  - type: manual

consts:
  corpus_id: "argus-corpus-mythos-2026-04"
  corpus_index: ".soc-eval-corpus-argus-corpus-mythos-2026-04"
  emission_source: "soc-argus-frontier-simulator"

steps:
  # ── Guard: only emit when the Mythos preset is armed ────────────────
  - name: preset_state
    type: elasticsearch.request
    with:
      method: GET
      path: "/.soc-difficulty-state/_doc/current"

  - name: gate_preset_armed
    type: console
    with:
      message: "{% if steps.preset_state.output._source.preset_armed == 'level-6' %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}"

  # Pick a random variant from the pre-seeded corpus (only when armed)
  - name: pick_variant_when_armed
    type: if
    condition: "steps.gate_preset_armed.output: yes"
    steps:
      - name: pick_variant
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: "{{ consts.corpus_index }}"
          size: 1
          query:
            function_score:
              query:
                bool:
                  filter:
                    - term:
                        _argus.corpus_id: "{{ consts.corpus_id }}"
                    - term:
                        _argus.should_fire:
                          value: true
              random_score: {}
              boost_mode: replace

      # We re-emit via _reindex + inline Painless so ES copies the full
      # source document (including nested ECS objects like host/process/event)
      # without Liquid having to stringify them. The script overwrites the
      # @timestamp + marks the copy as a simulation emission, and reassigns
      # _id so we get a fresh document each tick.
      - name: emit_variant
        type: elasticsearch.request
        with:
          method: POST
          path: "/_reindex?refresh=true"
          body:
            source:
              index: "{{ consts.corpus_index }}"
              query:
                ids:
                  values:
                    - "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._id }}"
            dest:
              index: "{{ consts.corpus_index }}"
            script:
              lang: painless
              source: "ctx._source['@timestamp'] = params.now; if (ctx._source._argus == null) { ctx._source._argus = new HashMap(); } ctx._source._argus.is_simulation_emission = true; ctx._source._argus.source = params.src; ctx._source._argus.emission_id = params.emid; ctx._id = params.emid;"
              params:
                now: "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
                src: "{{ consts.emission_source }}"
                emid: "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%s' }}-{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.primitive_id }}"

      - name: heartbeat
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-audit-trail
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            event_type: argus_frontier_simulator_tick
            source: "{{ consts.emission_source }}"
            corpus_id: "{{ consts.corpus_id }}"
            primitive_id: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.primitive_id }}"
            variant_axis: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.variant_axis }}"
            variant_index: "{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.variant_index }}"
            emission_id: "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%s' }}-{{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.primitive_id }}"

      - name: log_done
        type: console
        with:
          message: "Frontier simulator tick complete — emitted {{ steps.pick_variant.output.hits.hits[0]._source._argus.primitive_id }}"

  - name: skipped_heartbeat
    type: if
    condition: "steps.gate_preset_armed.output: no"
    steps:
      - name: log_skipped
        type: console
        with:
          message: "Frontier simulator: preset not armed, skipping emission"
      - name: heartbeat_skipped
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-audit-trail
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' }}"
            event_type: argus_frontier_simulator_skipped
            source: "{{ consts.emission_source }}"
            reason: preset_not_armed
